svg.text: Four tables · primary keys · foreign keys · cardinality
THE BILLING UNIT · one row per real-world family
ONE ROW PER MONEY EVENT · immutable
FIELD OWNERSHIP — read this when wiring forms
families ↔ father_name · mother_name · phone · address · p_dues (editing on any sibling propagates to all siblings)
students ↔ name · class · roll_no · dob · date_of_admission · aadhaar_no · pen · *_override · concession_reason · status (per-student, never shared)
payments ↔ fee_head · period · amount · paid_on · payment_mode · reference_no · notes · status (one immutable row per money event)
